# Mirrors env/environment.yml but expressed as pip packages, for the packaging
# pipeline. The canonical development environment remains the conda one
# (see env/environment.yml). Install with:
#

# Notes:
#   * conda ships PyQt6 under the package name `pyqt`; on PyPI it is `PyQt6`.
#   * img2pdf transitively installs pikepdf + lxml (PDF export backend).
